units.source_text: 他的手艺确是巧夺天工。

en.t: His craftsmanship was truly almost beyond human skill.

units.source_text: 他一个接一个地下了小小的决断，

en.t: He made one small decision after another,

units.source_text: 准确地集中发挥对比和匀整的艺术效果，

en.t: precisely concentrating and bringing out the artistic effects of contrast and balance,

units.source_text: 使自然的植物在一定的旋律下转移到人工的秩序里，

en.t: so that natural plants were transferred, under a certain rhythm, into an artificial order,

units.source_text: 显示出一派美妙的图景。
天然的花和叶，转眼间变形为应有的花和叶，

en.t: Natural flowers and leaves were transformed in an instant into the flowers and leaves they ought to be,

units.source_text: 那些木贼草和燕子花已经不是同类植物的无名的一株株，

en.t: and those horsetails and irises were no longer nameless individual plants of their respective kinds,

units.source_text: 而是经过创造者以简洁的直叙手法，

en.t: but rather, through the creator's concise and direct method,

units.source_text: 表现出木贼草的本质、燕子花的本质来。

en.t: they expressed the essence of the horsetail and the essence of the iris.
